title: evalharness result record
description: One result for one case, in one arm, on one repeat. A value the run did not produce is null, never 0 or an empty string.

schema_version.description: The version of this record contract. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

case_id.description: The identifier of the case. It is the same across every arm and every repeat, so records pair by it.

arm.description: The label of the configuration under test.

repeat.description: The zero-based index of this run of the case in this arm. A single run is repeat 0.

response_text.description: The answer the system under test produced. Null when the system produced no answer; an empty string is an answer, not an absence.

response_sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of response_text encoded as UTF-8. Null exactly when response_text is null.

criteria.description: The judge's verdict for each criterion, keyed by criterion name. The judge supplies these; it never supplies overall.

verdict.description: pass or fail when the criterion was judged; unscored when it could not be judged. Unscored is not a fail and not a pass.

gating.description: True when this criterion takes part in the overall computation.

reason.description: The judge's stated reason for the verdict. Null when the judge gave none.

graded.description: A graded score on a 0 to 5 scale, when the criterion carries one. Null when it does not; null is not 0.

overall.description: The case verdict, computed by the harness from criteria and never supplied by a judge: fail if any gating criterion is fail; else unscored if any gating criterion is unscored; else pass.

judge.description: The judge that produced the criteria verdicts. Null when the record was not judged.

model.description: The model identifier of the judge, as requested.

prompt_sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the judge prompt template, so a prompt change is visible in the record.

provider.description: The provider that served the judge. Null when unknown.

cost.description: What the run of this case cost, with its basis. Absent cost is a basis, never a zero amount.

basis.description: priced: an amount from a dated price list. self_hosted: the run used local compute with no per-call price. unpriced: no price is known.

amount.description: The cost in currency units. Non-null only when basis is priced. A zero amount is legal only under priced, with its snapshot date.

currency.description: The currency of amount. Required when basis is priced.

price_snapshot_date.description: The date of the price list that gave amount. Required when basis is priced.

latency.description: Raw timings in milliseconds. The model latency is wall_ms minus harness_ms, derived in reports and never stored.

wall_ms.description: The wall-clock time from the start of the case to its end.

harness_ms.description: The part of wall_ms the harness itself spent, outside the system under test.

failure_class.description: How the run of the case failed, or none. no_answer: the system returned no answer. parse_error: the answer could not be parsed. tool_error: a tool call failed. iteration_cap: the system hit its step limit. timeout: the run hit its time limit. framework_error: the harness or framework failed.

provenance.description: What actually served the case, as reported by the provider, not as requested.

served_model.description: The model identifier the provider reports it served. Null when the provider does not report one.

provider.description: The provider or endpoint that served the case. Null when unknown.

sampling.description: The sampling and reasoning settings in effect, as provider-specific key-value pairs. Null when unknown. Its keys are open because they differ by provider.

weights_digest.description: A digest of the model weights, where one exists (self-hosted models). Null otherwise.

started_at.description: The UTC time the case started, as an RFC 3339 date-time with a Z or +00:00 offset.
